v12.42: with a send of this phone's own still waiting for a reference, a unit another phone ticked there is not lost: both ticks are kept and go up together, and nothing else is written
v12.42: on any copy the later tick wins unit by unit, other units are kept, the histories join, and a record holding only these is kept
